slides.label: Astrology, tested
slides.title: Saturn, Chiron and Lilith: the three that held
slides.text: What I found when I checked my own chart like an invoice.

slides.title: About a third held
slides.text: Sun, rising, Venus, Mercury: 30 to 40%. Close to what a flattering horoscope scores.

slides.label: Saturn
slides.title: The hardest teacher
slides.text: A timetable, not a wall: what will take you longer, then what you’ll teach.

slides.label: Chiron
slides.title: The wound you keep circling
slides.text: Often where you’re best at caring for other people.

slides.label: Lilith
slides.title: What you were told to hide
slides.text: Not something to fix. Something to put back on the table.

slides.title: 75 to 90% held
slides.text: For me and for the people I tested. A notebook, not a study.
